name: Breathing Space
description: A soft shape that grows and shrinks to a gentle breathing pattern. Install a breathing pack to choose the pattern. Your place is saved.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A shape that grows and shrinks to a gentle breathing pattern. The pattern comes from a breathing pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow the shape for a few rounds, or stop whenever you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape grows and out as it shrinks. The words and the number on screen say the same thing.
Press Pause to stop the timer, then Continue to pick up where you were.
Press Restart to go back to the first round.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
With reduced motion on, the shape stays still and the words and numbers guide you.
This is a calm moment, not advice or treatment.
